conceptPrompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, implementable desktop website concept for the Chinese editorial cultural website “日常有来处”. Art direction: contemporary cultural journal, generous negative space, warm paper background #F6F2EA, dark ink #242B28, muted earthy gray, cinnabar #9B3D30, moss green #315E57. Refined Chinese Song serif headlines, clean sans serif UI. Thin rules, square edges, no gradients, no drop shadows, no card containers, no decorative pills, no hero eyebrow above heading. Clear accurately rendered Chinese text; text and controls will be code native. Small simple red square seal with the character 日, then serif brand. Header nav exact: 生活主题 / 小行动 / 阅读清单 / 关于与来源. Practical responsive HTML/CSS, 1280px-wide composition. No invented metrics or claims. Primary screen: homepage first viewport, 1536x1024 screenshot. Header within centered wide margins, navigation right. Airy split hero: left large two-line exact heading “把今天的日子，\n放进更长的时间里看。” at around 52px, below two lines “从人情、吃饭、居住与忙闲出发，\n读懂过去，也重新看见自己的生活。” and a deep cinnabar button “从一件小事开始” with a right arrow. Right a beautiful rectangular editorial art photograph: sunlit tabletop by a window, antique unlettered stitched book next to a plain modern off-white ceramic mug, a branch with green leaves in a small pottery vase, warm soft shadows, linen, quiet natural scene. Photo about 550x400, no overlay. Below hero generous whitespace then thin dividing rule, a search row headed “最近，你在为哪件小事费心？” and a search field “试试「随礼」「休息」「买东西」”, then a row of five text categories 人与人 / 时间与自己 / 物与居所 / 吃饭这件事 / 节日与共同生活. At bottom preview next section title “从日常出发”. Overall sophisticated understated, meaningful photographic focal point.

Practical responsive HTML/CSS, 1280px-wide composition. No invented metrics or claims. Primary screen: standalone homepage lower editorial section, 1536x1024. Top left large serif heading “从日常出发”, right text link “查看全部主题” with arrow. Three borderless editorial article columns, each image 3:2 ratio, then tiny category text, serif title and short muted summary and textual link. First image a textured red envelope on a linen table next to white flowers, title “随礼越来越贵，
不跟会不会伤感情？” category “人与人”, summary “把心意、成本和表达，分开想一想。” link “读这一篇”. Second image evening window with moonlight leaves and a wooden chair, category “时间与自己”, title “什么也没做，
这个晚上就浪费了吗？” summary “从一场夜游，重新看看闲暇。” Third image green leafy branch and a pottery bowl, category “物与居所”, title “买得越有品位，
为什么反而越难满足？” summary “拥有之前，先问问自己怎样使用。” No individual cards or rounded wrappers. Beneath this three-column row, full width very pale sage horizontal band with small caption 今天试一试, left large heading “给生活留一点观察的余地。”, small text “不必打卡，也不必证明一种方法有效。” and right button “挑一个小行动”. Bottom quiet footer with brand and “原文有出处，建议有边界。” and “编辑原则”. All generous editorial whitespace.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, implementable desktop website concept for the Chinese editorial cultural website “日常有来处”. Art direction: contemporary cultural journal, generous negative space, warm paper background #F6F2EA, dark ink #242B28, muted earthy gray, cinnabar #9B3D30, moss green #315E57. Refined Chinese Song serif headlines, clean sans serif UI. Thin rules, square edges, no gradients, no drop shadows, no card containers, no decorative pills, no hero eyebrow above heading. Clear accurately rendered Chinese text; text and controls will be code native. Small simple red square seal with the character 日, then serif brand. Header nav exact: 生活主题 / 小行动 / 阅读清单 / 关于与来源. Practical responsive HTML/CSS, 1280px-wide composition. No invented metrics or claims. Primary screen: article reading page at desktop 1536x1024, same brand and navigation header. Wide outer margins. Top small functional back link “返回生活主题”. Main article column 750px wide, right slim sticky table of contents column 200px separated only by whitespace. Main large serif title on two lines “随礼越来越贵，\n不跟会不会伤感情？”. Small metadata line “人与人 · 儒家礼论”. Short intro “心意很真，负担也很真。先把它们分开。” Thin rule. Body section heading “01  你想祝福，为什么先开始算账？” followed by three short Chinese prose paragraphs in easily readable 19px body font and generous 1.9 line spacing. Below heading “02  礼也讨论过形式与分寸” and a quote with slim cinnabar left line “礼，与其奢也，宁俭。” beside source link “《论语·八佾》3.4”. Right contents caption “本篇目录” with six links “现代场景 / 古代对应 / 古今对照 / 取舍与转化 / 生活实践 / 来源与延伸”, with first selected in cinnabar, and below thin rule two controls 收藏文章 and 分享. No photograph in article header; reading focused, open layout. Include lower glimpse of sage-tinted modern practice callout. Legible scholarly-yet-warm editorial design.
